race.comment: LIGHTENING KISS (5) missed the kick but gathered momentum late and was beaten under a length by Flying Low (engaged in Race 1) over this trip at Muswellbrook last start. Can deliver a more polished performance with that experience on board. The other chances in the race all resume from spells so she has that race fitness advantage. Looks the testing material. GET LITT (3) returns from a 28-week spell. Best effort of four in the maiden campaign as a narrow defeat over 1250m at Newcastle at start two. Can win with a repeat of that effort. Lightly raced six-year-old mare YASENA (6) also resumes. Wasn't beaten far at her only run last prep over 900m at Wellington. Right in the mix with a similar return today. LADY OF MALAY (8) and LEPPITSCH (9) are also first-up. Struggling to make a winning case for either runner but they are trifecta/first four hopes.
